name: room-probes-mobile
description: R7-L ladder, MOBILE rung. True phone viewport (390x844, `viewport` step — Chrome's resize_window clamps at ~606 px) with coarse pointer. Two things to prove, and the second is the one that matters: (1) the feature renders correctly in walk mode on a phone-shaped canvas; (2) it costs a PHONE NOTHING. A phone boots `performance/weak`, which has `ibl: false` and `roomProbeResolution: 0`, so the probe must allocate zero bytes there — this rung asserts the VRAM figure directly rather than trusting the tier table, because the whole point of the R7-H KTX2 brief was reclaiming phone VRAM and this feature must not hand it back.

steps.name: setup
steps.eval: (() => { try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.dismissChecklist?.(); s.setTimeMode?.('manual'); s.setManualHour?.(13); s.setLightsMode?.('off'); s.hideLoading?.() })()

steps.name: assert-zero-cost-on-the-phone-tier
steps.eval: (() => { let n = 0; window.__three.scene.traverse((o) => { const m = o.material; if (m && !Array.isArray(m) && m.userData && m.userData.roomProbeRecord) n++ }); const tex = window.__three.gl.info.memory.textures; console.log('[probe] phone tier patched=' + n + ' textures=' + tex); if (n !== 0) throw new Error('the phone tier allocated ' + n + ' room-probe patches; it must allocate none') })()

steps.name: assert-weak-uses-the-cheaper-probe
steps.eval: (() => { const centres = new Set(); window.__three.scene.traverse((o) => { const m = o.material; const r = m && !Array.isArray(m) && m.userData && m.userData.roomProbeRecord; if (r) centres.add(r.uniforms.center.value.toArray().join(',')) }); console.log('[probe] realistic/weak probes=' + centres.size + ' (128 cube => ' + (centres.size * 1.5).toFixed(1) + ' MB)'); if (centres.size === 0) throw new Error('realistic/weak carries no probes'); if (centres.size > 4) throw new Error('VRAM budget blown: ' + centres.size) })()

steps.name: hide-hud
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); s.hideLoading?.(); s.dismissCallout?.('walk-mode'); s.dismissCallout?.('walk-move'); s.dismissChecklist?.() })()

steps.name: p-kitchen
steps.eval: (() => { const l = window.__walkLook; l.setPosition(8.8, 7.4); l.setYaw(2.05); l.setPitch(-0.05) })()

steps.name: p-bath1
steps.eval: (() => { const l = window.__walkLook; l.setPosition(2.69, 5.3); l.setYaw(3.1416); l.setPitch(-0.05) })()

steps.name: cost-phone
steps.eval: (() => { const a = window.__three.advance; for (let i = 0; i < 15; i++) a(performance.now() / 1000, true); const t0 = performance.now(); for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) a(performance.now() / 1000, true); console.log('[probe] ARM=phone-realistic-weak frameMs=' + ((performance.now() - t0) / 60).toFixed(3) + ' textures=' + window.__three.gl.info.memory.textures) })()
